jobs.name: Explore TDE Mode
jobs.description: Read-only exploration of TDE mode code to understand the hang issue
jobs.prompt: You are investigating a Chrome browser hang caused by TDE (Tidal Disruption Event) mode in the BlackholeSim project. Start by exploring the codebase to understand: 1) What TDE mode does, 2) How it's triggered, 3) What rendering/animation loop it uses, 4) Any obvious infinite loops or blocking calls. Look at src/ directory, especially files related to TDE, simulation, and rendering. Report findings with file paths and line numbers.

jobs.name: Architect TDE Fix
jobs.description: Read-only architecture analysis of the TDE hang root cause
jobs.prompt: Based on the exploration findings, architect the root cause of the TDE mode Chrome hang. Analyze: 1) The execution flow when TDE mode is active, 2) Potential infinite loops or missing break conditions, 3) RequestAnimationFrame or setInterval usage, 4) Heavy computation blocking the main thread, 5) WebGL/WebGPU rendering pipeline issues. Provide a detailed architectural diagnosis with specific code locations.

jobs.name: Finalize Fix Plan
jobs.description: Read-only validation of the proposed fix approach
jobs.prompt: Review the architecture diagnosis and finalize a concrete fix plan. Validate: 1) Is the root cause identified correctly? 2) Is the proposed fix minimal and targeted? 3) Are there side effects to consider? 4) What is the exact code change needed? Provide a validated fix plan with specific file modifications.

jobs.name: Implement TDE Fix
jobs.description: Write-capable implementation of the TDE hang fix
jobs.prompt: Implement the validated fix for the TDE mode Chrome hang. Make the specific code changes identified in the fix plan. Ensure: 1) The fix addresses the root cause, 2) No new bugs are introduced, 3) Code follows existing style conventions. Report what was changed and why.

jobs.name: Run Deterministic Checks
jobs.description: Read-only automated validation of the fix
jobs.prompt: Run all available lint, typecheck, and build commands to verify the fix doesn't break anything. Check: 1) TypeScript compilation, 2) ESLint or similar linters, 3) Build process, 4) Any existing tests. Report pass/fail status and any issues found.
